description: Source code for handling Random Access Channel (RACH) procedures in a MAC layer implementation, including preamble management, RACH indication handling, and cell management.

classes.name: mac_cell_rach_handler_impl
classes.description: Implementation of RACH handling for a specific cell, managing preambles and RACH indications.

classes.name: mac_rach_handler
classes.description: Main RACH handler managing multiple cells and coordinating RACH procedures.

methods.name: is_cfra_preamble
methods.description: Checks if a given preamble ID corresponds to a contention-free RACH preamble.

methods.name: get_cfra_index
methods.description: Returns the index of a contention-free preamble within the preamble array.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication
methods.description: Processes a RACH indication, creating scheduler messages and allocating RNTIs.

methods.name: handle_cfra_allocation
methods.description: Handles contention-free RACH preamble allocation for a UE.

methods.name: handle_cfra_deallocation
methods.description: Deallocates a contention-free RACH preamble for a UE.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the RACH handler with specific configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the RACH handler.
